chapter_title: 第173章 就當是取材了

segments.title: 第173章 就當是取材了
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Era Chapter 173 Just Treat it as Gathering Material

The outdoor basketball court of Attached No. 1 High School was located in the northwest corner of the campus.

Standing by the wall on the north side of the court and looking out, you could see the wide Yin River flowing and rushing past the roadside.

Occasionally, you could even see boats passing under the cross-river bridge.

The basketball courts were all cement surfaces, with a total of five courts planned side-by-side and ten hoops.

At Attached No. 1 High School, the basketball club had over a hundred members. Basically, anyone who knew how to play had joined.

However, at least 50 of them couldn't be considered true members of the basketball club. At most, they were idle individuals like Li Luo, who only occasionally participated in a few games after joining.

The remaining thirty to forty people, including some of the third-year seniors who had already left the club, were the true members of the basketball club and were responsible for organizing this event.

For example, Zhu Yufei, Lin Yuan, and Zhang Guohuang from Class Eight were like this.

The three of them were in charge of the most remote hoop in the northwest corner, taking turns to teach students who came to try out basketball how to shoot.

For the average boy, they would just let him shoot some free throws from the free-throw line.

If it was a girl who couldn't even hit the rim from the free-throw line, they would have them stand directly under the hoop, find the 45-degree angle best for banking the ball in, and let them have some fun.

Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang were quite enjoying themselves.

Although neither of them had a girl they liked at the moment, their hearts were still quite restless.

When girls came to line up to play, the two of them simply stationed themselves there and went nowhere else.

Every now and then, they would pull off a three-step layup or something, enjoying the amazed gazes from the girls while trying to look cool.

As for Lin Yuan, with the help of his two good buddies, he stayed for about half an hour before slipping away to accompany Xiuxiu to check out the other club activities.

However, because the hoop Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang were in charge of was the farthest from the basketball court entrance.

So, by the time it was past three in the afternoon, fewer and fewer people were coming to their area to line up.

Especially at the two hoops closest to the entrance, where members of the school basketball team were showing off, many girls were intercepted there.

For many girls, coming to the basketball court to play was less about the effort of shooting the ball themselves and more about watching the cool and dashing figures of the handsome guys playing.

Thus, when Li Luo brought Xu Youyu to the hoop in the northwest corner, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang had already been playing one-on-one for quite a while.

"Hey, Class President, what brings you here?" Zhu Yufei was the first to notice Li Luo's figure. He raised his eyebrows, then his gaze fell on Xu Youyu. "This seems to be... a second-year senior, right?"

"You've seen the great and famous student council president, aren't you going to come and pay your respects?" Li Luo said, borrowing her prestige.

"Are you that childish?" Xu Youyu shot him a look. "I'm just here to play for a bit."

Some people in Class Eight knew that besides his good relationships with Yan Zhusheng and Ying Chanxi, Li Luo was also on good terms with this second-year president.

They could often be seen eating together in the cafeteria.

And day students often saw Li Luo, Ying Chanxi, and Xu Youyu heading home together after school.

So, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang didn't find Xu Youyu's arrival strange at all.

It was just that Zhang Guohuang asked curiously, "Isn't Yan Zhusheng with you?"

"She's over at the rock club, having fun."

"No wonder." Zhu Yufei nodded and tossed a basketball to Li Luo. "Zhang Guohuang and I are taking a break anyway. You're also a member of the basketball club, so the senior is all yours, right?"

Li Luo caught the basketball and gave the two of them an OK sign, then looked at Xu Youyu. "Senior, we've played once before. How do you want to play today?"

"What were they playing just now?" Xu Youyu asked curiously.

"One-on-one," Li Luo said. "That's what it means. You want to try that, senior?"

"I definitely can't beat you."

"You can add some restrictions." Li Luo said with a smile, "You're here to have fun, so you can be on offense the whole time. I'll only play defense."

"Not enough." Xu Youyu shook her head repeatedly. "Last time, you blocked Xixi's shots so hard. The moment you raise your hand, I won't even be able to get the ball up."

"Your demands are really high." Li Luo rolled his eyes at her. After tossing her the ball, he simply put both hands behind his back. "Is this okay? I'll give you a two-hand handicap."

"This is good." Xu Youyu nodded in satisfaction with a smile. After catching the ball, she stood outside the three-point line. "I'll start from here then?"

"Go ahead." Li Luo walked over and stood in front of her, his hands behind his back. "Don't worry about rules like traveling, but you have to keep dribbling. You can't just run with the ball in your arms, okay?"

"OK." Xu Youyu gave him a gesture, looking eager to start. "Here I come then."

Xu Youyu's personality was quite different from most girls.

She had a casual demeanor and didn't care much for the reserve and subtlety of some girls.

When playing basketball, she was also very uninhibited, charging right over without any hesitation about her movements.

Unlike some girls who would act all timid and awkward when holding a basketball.

As Li Luo was thinking this, Xu Youyu had already started her offense towards his left side.

Seeing her ferocious attack, Li Luo's eyes widened in surprise.

In that brief moment of distraction, Xu Youyu had already passed his left side, quickly dribbled to the basket, and with both hands, tossed the ball up with force.

A precise shot, straight off the backboard and into the hoop.

"What were you spacing out for?" Xu Youyu asked strangely. "You're throwing the game, and it's way too obvious."

"I was planning to throw it," Li Luo's mouth twitched. "But you launched a mental attack on me and left me stunned on the spot."

"What nonsense are you talking about?" Xu Youyu looked at him speechlessly, holding the ball as she returned to the three-point line. "Again. At least put in a little effort, otherwise, I won't feel anything."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo said with a laugh. "Come on, I'm ready this time."

"Then here I come."

He said he was ready, but when Xu Youyu came at him with the ball again, Li Luo couldn't help but take a few extra glances.

Plus, with his hands behind his back the whole time, he couldn't really mount an effective defense, and Xu Youyu could travel all she wanted.

So the second time, she also made it under the basket very smoothly and sank the shot directly.

However, this time, with some defensive resistance from Li Luo, Xu Youyu felt fully immersed. After scoring, she happily gave Li Luo a victory sign. "I scored again. Are you any good?"

"Hah."

Li Luo returned to his defensive position and said to Xu Youyu, "I've figured out your offense now. Again."

And so, the two quickly entered round after round of offense and defense.

Under Li Luo's intentional control, Xu Youyu had a blast.

After just over ten minutes, she already felt her mouth was dry and her whole body was hot.

Even in the middle of winter, she had taken off her coat and still felt warm in just a sweater.

Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang watched from a nearby bench, clicking their tongues from time to time.

"The class president is really throwing the game."

"This isn't throwing the game, he's throwing the whole ocean."

"Why don't we have a girl like the senior to play basketball with us?"

"Are you better than the class president?"

"My standards aren't that high. Someone like Ren Zheng or Xu Yinghuan would be fine."

"Whoa, you've exposed yourself."

"I'm just giving an example. Otherwise, for a girl like the senior, I feel like only Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng could match up."

"Aren't those still the girls around our class president?"

"Now that you mention it, you're right. He's even more damnable than the protagonist of that book, 'I'm Really Not a Superstar'."

The two of them were idly chatting over there.

On the court, the two were still going back and forth.

But by now, Xu Youyu was getting a little tired. She quickly called for a stop, and they stopped playing one-on-one, switching to a free-throw shooting game.

Finally, Xu Youyu was truly exhausted. She waved her hand and walked over to the bench, giving the court back to Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang.

So the two guys picked up the ball and went back to playing one-on-one, leaving Li Luo and Xu Youyu to rest on the bench.

Drinking the water Li Luo had given her earlier, Xu Youyu took a large gulp, letting out a satisfied sigh.

Then she turned to look at Li Luo, saw that he didn't seem to have any extra water, and asked, "Do you want some?"

"Is that a good idea?" Li Luo glanced at the water bottle in Xu Youyu's hand. The rim seemed to still have some of the senior's saliva on it. "You've already drunk from it."

"Are you disgusted by me?" Xu Youyu raised an eyebrow, teasing, "I don't mind. Do you have mysophobia?"

"Not really." Li Luo recalled the days he spent with Xu Youyu in his past life. This kind of situation wasn't exactly unheard of.

It could only be said that Xu Youyu was still the same Xu Youyu. Once she accepted you, she wouldn't care about these kinds of details.

So Li Luo didn't refuse anymore. He took the water bottle directly from her hand, but instead of drinking from the rim, he held it away from his mouth, slowly tilted it, and caught the stream of water below.

After a few sips, he returned the bottle to Xu Youyu.

"What do you want to play next?" Li Luo asked. "There's badminton and table tennis over at the sports field."

"Let's skip those two." Xu Youyu waved her hands repeatedly. "I'm almost dead tired from basketball. Let's switch to something more relaxing."

"Then let's go browse the stalls?"

"Alright." Xu Youyu nodded, finished the water in one go, threw the bottle into a nearby trash can, and then stood up. "Let's go. We can just treat it as going on patrol and browse around at the same time."

"Does the student council president have any special privileges?" Li Luo walked beside her towards Houde Road. "Like not having to wait in line or something?"

"You wish. What privileges do I have?" Xu Youyu rolled her eyes at him. "I wasn't even planning to play in the first place. It's all your fault."

"You were clearly having so much fun just now." Li Luo teased with a smile. "Who was it that was playing so energetically a moment ago?"

"You talk a lot." Xu Youyu pouted and said stubbornly without hesitation, "We made it clear before. You were the one who begged me to come play. I was just keeping you company."

Just treat it as gathering material.

Xu Youyu thought to herself.

(End of this chapter)
